independentMethod: Z-function computes prefix matches at each position; test divisors of total length for complete coverage, independent of prefix-function period formula.

mutations.label: Erases genuine spaces from input line
mutations.replace: for (size_t at = s.find(' '); at != string::npos; at = s.find(' ')) s.erase(at, 1); if (s.empty()) s = "x"; int n = s.size();
